speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Both Members have given notice of their intention to move their Motions tomorrow, that is to say, on 14 September 2021.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: For benefit of the Members, let me read out the terms of the Motions as they are not on today's Order Paper, since they will be on tomorrow's Order Paper.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: This is because the two Motions cover common topics and related issues, albeit from different perspectives.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: A concurrent or simultaneous debate will allow Members to address both Motions in a single speech and enable the issues raised in the two Motions to be considered holistically.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: It will also allow for more efficient conduct of parliamentary business.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The Question is as moved by Leader of the House.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The Clerk will now proceed to read the Orders of the day.
